headline: Jason Isbell and Others Say Suno’s A.I. Imitates Their Voices
context: Jason Isbell and three others filed a lawsuit against Suno, accusing the company of training its model on their songs. The suit will test a legal strategy not based on copyright but unlawful imitation.
